name: Build and Steal Brainrots!
desc:
⚠️ We have a new game: https://www.roblox.com/games/132016691802922/Build-a-Base-and-Steal

🤗 Welcome to Build and Steal! 

💸 EARN MONEY EVEN WHILE YOU’RE OFFLINE! 💸

How to Play:
• ✨ Collect Brainrots for money
• 🎨 Design your own base
• ⚔️ Fight other players with mystery gear
• 🤫 Sneak into other bases and steal their brainrots
